verdicts.reason: A keeps the original top-to-bottom order with a strong headline and clear orange CTA. But the header band is squeezed so the SOLSTICE logo is almost invisible, the body copy is tiny, and the legal block at the bottom is as large as the body text and crowds the edge. B buries the CTA as a tiny pill, while the bottom-left body paragraph is set larger than anything but the headline, so the hierarchy is inverted. B's legal text and 'Ships late June' are unreadably small in a cramped right column, which makes the bottom half look lopsided and arbitrary.
